purpose: Teach: 泣ける/競っ/上っ/臨む/抜粋/シーツ/出迎え/ハプニング

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、昨日泣ける映画を見たの
lines.en: Sho, I watched such a touching movie yesterday.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself. Gentle warmth. Speaking to him like sharing a small, quiet moment. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お友達と競って絵を描いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I drew pictures with my friend! We were competing.
lines.style: Bright, quick momentum. Enthusiasm without trying too hard. Seeking approval but genuinely proud. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、お仕事の役職、上ったらしいわよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad got promoted at work, you know.
lines.style: Warm but measured. Not making a big announcement, just passing along something she noticed he'd want to hear. Calm affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、テストに臨む準備中だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm getting ready for my test.
lines.style: Calm determination underneath. Not anxious — serious and focused. Direct eye contact level. Small-voice confidence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、絵本の抜粋、メイ姉さん大好きよ
lines.en: Sho, I really love that excerpt from the picture book.
lines.style: Genuine delight, no performance. Speaking directly to him about something he's done well. Warm and unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、新しいシーツ、ふかふかだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my new sheets are so soft!
lines.style: Childish wonder bubbling up. Simple joy at a small discovery. Wanting to share it with her because she listens. Natural and unselfconscious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お客様の出迎え、メイ姉さん丁寧にしてるの
lines.en: Sho, I try to welcome our customers very carefully, you know.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost explaining something to herself through him. Pride in doing things well, but not boastful. Quiet attention to detail.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祭りで小さなハプニングあったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, something funny happened at the festival!
lines.style: Light, eager to tell. Already smiling. Building toward the story. Open and animated, trusting her to want to hear.
